# Open Problems Lab

> An open, collaborative AI-assisted problem-solving initiative for everyone. Investigates meaningful practical, business, technical, scientific, mathematical, engineering, educational and other questions with human insight, appropriate evidence, reproducibility and transparent review status.

Anyone can propose problems, contribute approaches, test results, and report counterexamples. No particular AI model, professional credential, or commercial objective is required. Initial projects are illustrative, not a restriction on the lab's scope.

## Start here

- [Research portfolio](https://github.com/zakkeasterbrook/open-problems-lab/blob/main/RESEARCH.md): Candidate findings, project links, proof and review status.
- [Machine-readable ledger](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/open-problems-lab/main/research/registry.json): Structured research identities and limitations.
- [Research protocol](https://github.com/zakkeasterbrook/open-problems-lab/blob/main/governance/RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md): Evidence, novelty, corrections and review.
- [Agent guide](https://github.com/zakkeasterbrook/open-problems-lab/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Scope and reproduction rules.
- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/zakkeasterbrook/open-problems-lab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Ways to participate and credit contributors.
- [Problem intake](https://github.com/zakkeasterbrook/open-problems-lab/blob/main/templates/PROBLEM.md): Record any meaningful question and its success criteria.
- [Publication policy](https://github.com/zakkeasterbrook/open-problems-lab/blob/main/governance/COMMERCIALIZATION.md): Confidentiality, responsible disclosure and potential commercial applications.
- [Citation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/open-problems-lab/main/CITATION.cff): Attribution for the initiative.

## Research

- [OPL-001: Prefix-reversal asymptotics](https://github.com/zakkeasterbrook/open-problems-lab/blob/main/research/mathematics/prefix-reversal-asymptotics/paper.md): Preliminary candidate proof of the interior generation criterion and leading asymptotic coefficients. Priority and independent review unverified.
- [OPL-002: PA5](https://github.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5): Published selective KV retrieval prototype; see numerical audit and stated limitations.
- [OPL-003: Adaptive Compute Barrier](https://github.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/tree/a916efe114992a5effcd05d7a8e7725867d4e650/research/adaptive-compute-barrier): Preliminary minimax stopping theorem and conditional analysis of aggregate research data.
- [OPL-004: Cazenave's spectral Randić conjecture](https://github.com/zakkeasterbrook/open-problems-lab/blob/main/research/mathematics/cazenave-randic-spectral/paper.md): Candidate complete deduction of Conjecture 1 and both stronger inequalities using Shaik's theorem. Exact finite verification reproduced; formal verification of the deduction, independent review and priority remain pending.

Open Problems Lab was founded by Zakk Easterbrook. Individual research authors, contributors and source researchers should be credited for their specific work. Use original project citations and exact commits. No DOI, priority or peer-review claim is made for the initiative.
